{{Lang|Jichen|zh= 既晨}} is an NPC found in {{Location|Hongzhen}}. 

==Profile==
Jichen and [[Jiye]] are former Hongzhen town guardians. Although their services are no longer needed, they still watch over the now peaceful Hongzhen. 

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Jichen:''' You're... What is it again... Rover! Right?
:{{DIcon}} Right
::'''Jichen:''' Hehe, you're the savior of Mt. Firmament, Rover. The people of Hongzhen are forever in your and the Magistrate's debt.
:{{DIcon}} Wrong
::'''Jichen:''' You kids sure love to joke around. I may be old, but my eyes are still sharp.
::'''Jichen:''' You're the savior of Mt. Firmament, Rover. The people of Hongzhen are forever in your and the Magistrate's debt.
:{{DIcon}} Do you know me?
::'''Jichen:''' Hehehe, there's nothing in town I don't know about, much less you and the Magistrate. You're the saviors of Mt. Firmament.
:'''Jichen:''' Hongzhen suffered the TD Outbreak generations back. It was Sentinel who preserved the town. 
:'''Jichen:''' But the joy we're relishing now is all thanks to you kids.
:'''Jichen:''' Out with the old, in with the new. The younger generation is pushing forward. Times sure are changing.
----
;(Daytime on the Rooftop)
:'''Jichen:''' Hey, we got a big crowd today. This is great.
:'''Jichen:''' Any more than this and my eyes won't be able to keep up.
:'''Jichen:''' ...
:'''Jichen:''' It's those brats again... I told them not to mess with the guests' stuff. What's so interesting about those walking suitcases anyway?
:'''Jichen:''' This won't do, I need to go over and have a word with them.
----
;(Nighttime sitting near [[Ruisheng]] stall)
:'''Jichen:''' See those Midnight Rangers?
:'''Jichen:''' What a relief. I was worried my old bones wouldn't last much longer, but now there's someone to carry on after me.
:{{DIcon}} Why is that?
:{{DIcon}} Have you crossed paths with the Midnight Rangers as well?
:'''Jichen:''' You asked the right question. There's a story behind it. Only a handful of young Mt. Firmament locals know about it.
:'''Jichen:''' Actually, Jiye and I are town guardians.
:'''Jichen:''' When we were young, we learned to fight from a master, before deciding to follow his footsteps and become guardians.
:{{DIcon}} Town guardians? You protect Hongzhen?
:'''Jichen:''' Yes. Speaking of which, Hongzhen has been through some really tough times. Ever since the TD Outbreak, the elders established a tradition of having guardians.
:'''Jichen:''' From then on, we guardians have been tasked with keeping watch from high paces all day, ready to alert everyone at the slightest sign of trouble.
:'''Jichen:''' Hehe, let me toot my own horn for a moment - Jiye and I were the first ones to sense the Temporal Disruption and notify everyone.
:'''Jichen:''' But the disruption was just an accident. Hongzhen hasn't had major problems for years under the Sentinel's blessings.
:'''Jichen:''' So we are the only guardians left in Hongzhen from our generation.
:'''Jichen:''' Ever since Mt. Firmament opened, Midnight Rangers are stationed here. Saw 'em today, young and full of spirit. More impressive than Jiye and I ever were.
:'''Jichen:''' So I thought maybe it's time these two old fogeys hang it up.
:'''Jichen:''' However, Jiye is just too stubborn, especially in his old age.
:'''Jichen:''' Well, I can't blame him, really. He's been at it for most of his life and just can't let go.
----
;(On the rooftop ontop of Souvenir Shop with Jiye)
:'''Jichen:''' Nothing suspicious happened last night, right?
:'''Jiye:''' Everything's fine...
:'''Jiye:''' You?
:'''Jichen:''' Same old, same old for the both of us.
:'''Jichen:''' Say, since the Midnight Rangers are here, shouldn't we retire?
:'''Jiye:''' ...
:'''Jichen:''' Look at you with that stubborn temper of yours. I was just spewing random thoughts. Why are you taking it so seriously?
:'''Jiye:''' ...
:'''Jichen:''' Sigh. You know, the  future of Hongzhen is in young people's hands. It's time we let it go.
{{Dialogue End}}
